messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: Re: melange_id for GSOC 2015
parts:
It looks like melange has recently done away with calling these 'melange
id' or 'link id'.

I see it now as 'username'

e.g. on the top of this link:

https://www.google-melange.com/gsoc/dashboard/google/gsoc2015

I see:

Logged in with account bgpbra...@gmail.com - username: braverock

There are many places where we need to know you 'username' on melange to
do administrative bits behind the scenes, which is why we ask for it on
all student applications.

Regards,

Brian
